blocks.text: PART XXI - How Śakti Invents Space and Time
blocks.directed: How Śakti Invents Space and Time

blocks.section: Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa
blocks.text: Abhinavagupta puts every letter of Sanskrit into every act of knowing, watches the Goddesses compete to manifest the universe, asks why Mount Meru isn't the size of an atom, explains how differentiated knowledge gives rise to space and differentiated activity to time, and turns the simple act of seeing something into a four-stage cosmic drama. Then the Sun and Moon begin swallowing one another's powers, and the whole thing returns to the magnificent divine “I.”
